lead_independence.headline: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man whose fiancée died in Monday house fire
lead_independence.lead: A Hobe Sound man is leaning on his community after losing his fiancée in a deadly home fire. Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause. The fire remains under investigation.

source_focus.source_title: Martin County Fire Rescue extinguishes golf cart fire in Hobe Sound - WPBF
source_focus.source_lead: Martin County Fire Rescue firefighters extinguished a golf cart fire in Hobe Sound that spread to a nearby home on Saturday night. The fire started just after 7 p.m. near the 8100 block of Southeast Eagle Avenue, just off Jimmy Buffett Memorial Highway (Southeast Dixie Highway), the agency said.
